capabilities: Add commands that open the next occurrence of each weekday's daily note
Pick dates with a picker supporting calendar dates, relative phrases, and recent daily notes
Create missing daily notes from the configured Daily Notes template
Route navigation through Journal View with its animations
Override the daily notes folder per plugin, including folder-containing date formats
extras: The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README states it works fully locally with no network services or telemetry.
intentEvidence: Configure your preferred date format, folder, and template in Obsidian's built-in Daily Notes plugin
problem: Obsidian's Daily Notes has no quick way to jump to the next occurrence of a specific weekday or to an arbitrary date from the command palette.

relations.evidence: It accepts calendar dates, natural-language dates when Natural Language Dates is installed
Integrate with Journal View (off by default): sends every Weekday Commands navigation to Journal View
or in Periodic Notes (with daily notes enabled)

summary: Command palette plugin that opens or creates daily notes by weekday commands or a date picker, using your Daily Notes template.
